# Priya Holds the Flame as Carl Brings the Whiplash
*Casa Amor-igos (demo league) · Week 3*

Week 3 brings a dramatic fire-pit roll call: Priya stays at the top, while the rest of the standings hold their places too. Carl’s arrival, return, and dump gave Dev a proper scoring roller coaster.

| # | Player | Total | This week | Move |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Priya | 101 | +17 | – |
| 2 | Dev | 68 | +4 | – |
| 3 | Jolie | 64 | +16 | – |
| 4 | Maya | 36 | +16 | – |

## The group chat report
- **Priya:** First place with 101 total points, and 17 this week—still holding the villa’s brightest flame. Corbin’s new couple added a little extra sparkle.
- **Dev:** Still in second with 68 total, but just 4 this week. Carl’s arrival and return brought points, then that dumped penalty slammed the brakes on the party.
- **Jolie:** Third place with 64 total and a lively 16 this week. Melanie and Sincere, plus Bryce and Trinity, each banked recoupling points for your team.
- **Maya:** Fourth with 36 total, matching Jolie’s 16 this week. Melanie and Sincere stayed coupled up and kept your week moving.

## Moments that moved the league
- Carl’s dumped penalty cost Dev 20 points—the week’s biggest swing, and a serious blow to the scoreboard.  
  <sub>Receipt: “On Day 20, Casa Amor islanders Amora, Carl, Chay, Corey, Ronnie, and Sydney were dumped from the island after failing to couple up.” · Dumped penalty (-20)</sub>
- Carl’s return earned Dev 10 points back, giving that roller coaster a welcome lift.  
  <sub>Receipt: “On Day 21, Amora and Carl re-entered the villa after the public voted them back in.” · Re-entered the villa (+10)</sub>
- Carl’s bombshell arrival added 5 points for Dev before the week’s later twists.  
  <sub>Receipt: “On Day 17, Carl, Chandlar, Chay, Corey, Dylan, Gal, Keyon, Kyle, Ronnie, Ryan, Tino and Trae entered the main villa.” · Bombshell arrival (+5)</sub>
- Kayda and Zach staying together paid 3 points apiece to Priya and Dev, rewarding both teams at the recoupling.  
  <sub>Receipt: “Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples.” · Survived a recoupling together (+3)</sub>
- Melanie and Sincere’s decision to stay together delivered 3 points apiece to Jolie and Maya.  
  <sub>Receipt: “Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples.” · Survived a recoupling together (+3)</sub>

_Next week, the fire pit will reveal whether anyone can turn the standings into a new story._
